1128152804697284608.a: He is so proud that he made a phone call from an antique FM radio it's adorable. It's called a phone patch. They cost like $40. Until Bush gutted military affiliate radio service and civil defense this was routine daily occurrence.

1128156863932108800.a: I got that award because we bid on the police radio system which had these features & the police chose a system that cost 10x more, no backup power, no patch capability, etc. We could patch to any vhf/uhf system on any frequency or replace any downed repeaters with 2 wks battery.

1128156865295208448.a: So we built & funded it ourselves. And when the entire county's power went out the only thing we noticed was our system went into our energy save mode. We patched fire, rescue, police, towing together for the entire county for a few days. We had forward and reverse phone patch.

1128159251359248384.a: We had the tallest tower in the county dead center on a ridgeline. An old Bell IMTS installation. It wasn't portable but it was small enough that would be trivial to do even for what we paid back then. Alarming at best if this is their emergency response plan in 2019.
